PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: 15th February 2026

Welcome to the Fintrack app ("we", "us", "our"), operated by Fintrack Technologies Private Limited.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when you
use our mobile application and website (collectively, the "Services").

This Privacy Policy is framed in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
(the "DPDP Act") and other applicable laws of India.

1. ROLES UNDER THE DPDP ACT

1.1 For the purposes of the DPDP Act, Fintrack Technologies Private Limited acts as the "Data
Fiduciary" in respect of personal data processed through the Services, and you, the user, are the
"Data Principal".

2. PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT

2.1 We collect personal data that you provide directly, including your name, mobile number, email
address, PAN, and bank account details, when you register for and use the Services.

2.2 We also collect personal data automatically, including device identifiers, IP address, app
usage data, and cookies, through the use of the Services.

3. HOW WE USE YOUR PERSONAL DATA

3.1 We use your personal data to provide and improve the Services, process transactions, respond to
your requests, comply with legal obligations, and, where you have given consent, to send you
promotional communications.

4. CONSENT

4.1 We process your personal data on the basis of your free, specific, informed, and unambiguous
consent, given through a clear affirmative action, in accordance with Section 6 of the DPDP Act.

4.2 You may withdraw your consent at any time through the "Privacy Settings" section of the app,
without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before such withdrawal.

5. SHARING OF PERSONAL DATA

5.1 We may share your personal data with our data processors, including cloud hosting providers and
payment gateways, strictly for the purposes described in this Policy, and with regulators and law
enforcement authorities where required by law.

5.2 We do not sell your personal data to any third party.

6. DATA RETENTION

6.1 We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in
this Policy, or as required under applicable law, after which it is securely deleted or anonymised.

7. YOUR RIGHTS AS A DATA PRINCIPAL

7.1 Subject to the DPDP Act, you have the right to access a summary of your personal data, request
correction or erasure of your personal data, nominate another individual to exercise your rights in
the event of death or incapacity, and grievance redressal.

7.2 You may exercise these rights by contacting our Grievance Officer at grievance@fintrack.example.

8. SECURITY

8.1 We implement reasonable security safeguards, including encryption and access controls, to
protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss, or disclosure.

9. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

9.1 We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes
through the app or by email.

10. CONTACT US

10.1 If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our handling of your personal data, please
contact our Grievance Officer at grievance@fintrack.example.
